title: CAP: from data model to working API

scenes.narration: A CAP entity describes your data, and a service projection exposes it through OData. Let's try this inventory app.
Start with Products: an ID, a title, and a stock count. Three sample rows are already in the project.
Now expose Products through InventoryService, and there's your API. It's read-only, so this example accepts queries and rejects creates.
In the terminal, type npm run demo. Open the Products URL and filter for stock above zero: the keyboard and dock are in stock.
Clear the filter to see all three products. Deployment and authentication are separate steps.
Try the project and its checks. Which entity would you expose first?
